description: Risk scorer and daily drawdown gate. Receives features, computes composite risk score (weighted formula over delta_price_pct, OBI, TFI, absorption), maintains daily drawdown gate with persistent state, and emits EVT:RISK_ASSESSMENT_COMPLETED with is_trading_allowed.

ssot_notes.risk_score: RiskManagement._calculate_risk_parameters (risk_management.py) is the canonical risk scorer
ssot_notes.daily_gate: DailyRiskState (daily_gate.py) is the canonical daily drawdown gate with persistent state
ssot_notes.why_codes: uses WhyCode from vfoundation/core/why_codes.py (RISK_DRAWDOWN_LIMIT, RISK_NOT_ALLOWED, RISK_SCORE_HIGH)
ssot_notes.exposure_ownership: EVT:EXPOSURE_SUMMARY_UPDATED was owned by RM until 2026-03-14, now owned by execution_position
